integrity: The proof first shows that the image of a weight-zero Rota-Baxter operator is a subalgebra, then uses finite-dimensional reduced commutative structure to obtain a nonzero image idempotent. Two applications of the Rota-Baxter identity rule out such an idempotent in every characteristic. Exhaustive finite split examples and a dual-number boundary example are independently replayed by the checker.
scientific_limitations: Finite dimensionality is used to obtain a nonzero idempotent inside a nonzero reduced image subalgebra.
The group-algebra corollary assumes nonmodular characteristic.
The theorem concerns weight-zero Rota-Baxter operators only.
title: Reduced finite commutative algebras admit no weight-zero Rota–Baxter operators
